issues.description: GPU TRES parsing matches any key starting with gres/gpu, so gpumem/gpuutil and typed+generic entries can inflate GPU-hour totals.
Ingest writes valid rows to the database before enforcing the malformed-row threshold, leaving partial data after a failed ingest.
Failure reports only match exact FAILED/TIMEOUT/OOM states, missing OUT_OF_MEMORY and state strings with Slurm detail suffixes.
Report windows compare timestamp strings instead of normalized datetimes, which can misorder timezone-aware values.
Rows with extra pipe-delimited columns are accepted silently because csv.DictReader extras are never checked.
Database initialization has no schema versioning or migrations, so older local databases can fail or behave inconsistently after schema changes.
SQLite connection and query failures are uncaught, so common DB path/permission/corruption errors produce tracebacks instead of CLI errors.
--since accepts date, naive datetime, and aware datetime inputs but returns mixed string formats that feed unsafe DB comparisons.
rows_to_text serializes pipe-delimited rows without escaping or validation, so values containing pipes or newlines corrupt generated fixtures.
